summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-binding going-private proposal from Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and founder/CEO Sumant Sinha to acquire all shares not owned by the Consortium at US$6.75 per share cash. The transaction will be structured as a UK scheme of arrangement, with shareholders receiving cash unless they affirmatively elect a rollover. A Special Committee of independent directors chaired by Manoj Singh is evaluating the proposal, advised by Rothschild & Co and Linklaters LLP. No assurance of a final deal exists. Watch for the Special Committee's recommendation and competing bids; risk-arb spread will hinge on regulatory clearance and shareholder vote.
